recipes.name: Idli
steps: Soak rice and urad dal with fenugreek separately for 6 hours.
Grind to a smooth batter, mix with salt and ferment overnight.
Steam in greased idli moulds for 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Rava idli
steps: Roast semolina in ghee with a tempering of mustard, chana dal, cashew and curry leaves.
Mix with curd and salt and rest 15 minutes.
Steam in idli moulds.

recipes.name: Plain dosa
steps: Soak, grind and ferment the rice and urad batter overnight.
Spread a ladle of batter thin on a hot tawa.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

recipes.name: Masala dosa
steps: Prepare and ferment dosa batter.
Make the potato palya with onion, mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and turmeric.
Cook crisp dosas, fill with palya and fold.

recipes.name: Rava dosa
steps: Mix semolina, rice flour and maida with water into a thin batter and rest 20 minutes.
Add onion, chilli, cumin and curry leaves.
Pour onto a very hot tawa, drizzle oil and cook until lacy and crisp.

recipes.name: Pesarattu
steps: Soak whole moong and rice for 4 hours.
Grind with ginger, chilli and cumin.
Spread thin on a tawa, sprinkle onion and cook with oil.

recipes.name: Ragi dosa
steps: Whisk ragi and rice flour with curd and water into a thin batter.
Add onion, chilli and cumin.
Pour onto a hot tawa like rava dosa and cook with oil.

recipes.name: Onion tomato uttapam
steps: Use fermented idli-dosa batter.
Spread thick on the tawa and top with onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Cook with oil on both sides.

recipes.name: Appam
steps: Soak rice and grind with coconut into a smooth batter.
Add sugar and salt and ferment overnight.
Swirl a ladle in a hot appachatti, cover and cook until the centre is soft.

recipes.name: Puttu
steps: Moisten rice flour with salted water until crumbly.
Layer with grated coconut in the puttu maker.
Steam for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.name: Rava upma
steps: Dry-roast semolina.
Temper mustard, dals, curry leaves, chilli, ginger and onion in oil.
Add boiling water and salt, stir in semolina and cook until fluffy.

recipes.name: Vegetable upma
steps: Roast semolina.
Temper and cook the vegetables until tender.
Add water, then semolina, and cook until fluffy.

recipes.name: Ven pongal
steps: Pressure-cook rice and moong dal with plenty of water until mushy.
Temper pepper, cumin, ginger, cashew and curry leaves in ghee.
Mix into the pongal.

recipes.name: Sakkarai pongal
steps: Cook rice and dal soft.
Melt jaggery with a little water, strain and add.
Finish with ghee-fried cashew, raisins and cardamom.

recipes.name: Medu vada
steps: Soak urad dal and grind into a thick fluffy batter.
Add onion, chilli, ginger, pepper and curry leaves.
Shape doughnuts and deep-fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Sambar
steps: Cook toor dal with turmeric until soft.
Simmer the vegetables in tamarind water with sambar powder until tender.
Add the dal and boil together.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and hing in oil.

recipes.name: Tomato rasam
steps: Crush pepper, cumin and garlic.
Boil tomato in tamarind water with the crushed spices.
Add thin cooked dal water and take off the heat at the first froth.
Temper with ghee, mustard, curry leaves and hing.

recipes.name: Lemon rice
steps: Cook rice and spread to cool.
Temper mustard, dals, peanuts, chilli, curry leaves and turmeric in oil.
Toss the rice with the tempering and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Curd rice
steps: Cook rice soft and mash lightly while warm.
Mix in curd, milk and salt once cool.
Top with a tempering of mustard, urad dal, curry leaves, ginger and chilli.

recipes.name: Tamarind rice
steps: Cook the tamarind pulp with jaggery and spices into a thick paste in sesame oil.
Temper peanuts, dals and curry leaves.
Mix the paste and tempering into cooled rice.

recipes.name: Coconut rice
steps: Cook and cool rice.
Temper mustard, dals, cashew and chilli in coconut oil and toast the coconut.
Toss with rice.

recipes.name: Bisi bele bath
steps: Cook rice and dal together until mushy.
Cook the vegetables in tamarind water with bisi bele bath powder.
Combine and finish with ghee, cashew and curry leaves.

recipes.name: Avial
steps: Cook the batons of vegetable with turmeric and salt.
Grind coconut with chilli and cumin and add to the vegetables.
Stir in curd, coconut oil and curry leaves.

recipes.name: Cabbage thoran
steps: Temper mustard, urad dal, chilli and curry leaves in coconut oil.
Add shredded cabbage, turmeric and salt and cook covered.
Toss with grated coconut.

recipes.name: Beans poriyal
steps: Chop beans fine.
Temper mustard, urad dal and curry leaves.
Cook beans with salt and a splash of water, then add coconut.

recipes.name: Carrot poriyal
steps: Grate or dice the carrots.
Temper mustard, urad dal and curry leaves.
Cook the carrot briefly and finish with coconut.

recipes.name: Mixed vegetable kootu
steps: Cook moong dal soft.
Cook the vegetables and add the dal.
Add ground coconut, cumin and chilli and simmer, then temper.

recipes.name: Keerai masiyal
steps: Cook greens with moong dal, garlic and chilli.
Mash well.
Temper mustard and cumin and stir in.

recipes.name: Vatha kuzhambu
steps: Temper mustard, fenugreek and curry leaves in sesame oil, add onion and garlic.
Add tamarind water and sambar powder and simmer until thick.
Finish with jaggery and a rice-flour slurry.

recipes.name: Mor kuzhambu
steps: Grind soaked toor dal, coconut, chilli, ginger and cumin.
Cook ash gourd, add the paste and whisked curd and heat without boiling.
Temper in coconut oil.

recipes.name: Chicken Chettinad
steps: Dry-roast pepper, fennel, coriander, chilli and coconut and grind into a masala.
Brown onion, ginger and garlic in oil, add tomato and chicken.
Add the masala and water and simmer until the chicken is done.

recipes.name: Kerala fish curry
steps: Sauté fenugreek, curry leaves, onion, ginger and garlic in coconut oil.
Add chilli, turmeric, tomato and tamarind water.
Slide in the fish, simmer until cooked and finish with coconut milk.

recipes.name: Masala fish fry
steps: Coat fish in a paste of chilli, turmeric, ginger, garlic, lemon and rice flour.
Rest 20 minutes.
Shallow-fry until crisp on both sides.

recipes.name: Prawn masala
steps: Fry onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves in coconut oil.
Add tomato and spices and cook into a thick masala.
Add prawns and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Kerala egg roast
steps: Boil and peel eggs.
Slow-cook a lot of sliced onion in coconut oil until jammy, add ginger, garlic and spices.
Add tomato and eggs and roast until coated.

recipes.name: Hyderabadi chicken dum biryani
steps: Marinate raw chicken in curd, fried onion, ginger, garlic, herbs, lemon and spices for 2 hours.
Boil rice to 70% with whole spices.
Layer the rice over the raw chicken, drizzle ghee, seal and cook on dum for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Hyderabadi vegetable biryani
steps: Marinate vegetables and paneer in curd, fried onion and spices.
Parboil rice with whole spices.
Layer and cook on dum for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Mirchi ka salan
steps: Roast peanuts, sesame and coconut and grind with onion.
Fry slit large chillies briefly.
Cook the paste in oil with tamarind and jaggery and simmer the chillies in it.

recipes.name: Tomato pappu
steps: Pressure-cook dal with tomato, chilli and turmeric.
Mash well.
Temper with garlic, mustard, cumin, curry leaves and chilli.

recipes.name: Andhra chicken fry
steps: Marinate chicken with chilli, turmeric, ginger and garlic.
Fry onion and curry leaves, add chicken and cook covered.
Uncover and roast with pepper and garam masala until dry.

recipes.name: Malabar parotta
steps: Knead maida with milk, egg, sugar, salt and oil into a soft dough and rest 2 hours.
Stretch very thin, pleat and coil.
Roll and cook on a tawa with oil, then clap to open the layers.

recipes.name: Kerala vegetable stew
steps: Sauté onion, ginger, chilli and curry leaves in coconut oil.
Cook the vegetables in thin coconut milk.
Finish with thick coconut milk and pepper.

recipes.name: Kerala chicken stew
steps: Sauté onion, ginger and chilli in coconut oil.
Add chicken, potato and thin coconut milk and simmer until cooked.
Finish with thick coconut milk and pepper.

recipes.name: Ragi mudde
steps: Bring water to a boil with salt.
Add ragi flour in a heap, cover 3 minutes, then stir vigorously.
Cook until it comes together and shape into balls with wet hands.

recipes.name: Ragi porridge
steps: Whisk ragi into cold water.
Cook stirring until thick, then add milk.
Sweeten with jaggery and cardamom.

recipes.name: Coconut chutney
steps: Grind coconut with roasted chana dal, chilli, ginger, salt and water.
Temper mustard and curry leaves in oil.

recipes.name: Tomato chutney
steps: Cook onion, garlic and tomato in oil until pulpy.
Add chilli and salt and grind.
Temper with mustard.

recipes.name: Chickpea sundal
steps: Boil soaked chickpeas until tender.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, chilli and hing.
Toss with chickpeas and coconut.

recipes.name: Kerala banana chips
steps: Slice raw bananas thin straight into hot coconut oil.
Fry until crisp, sprinkling salted turmeric water.
Drain and cool.

recipes.name: Semiya payasam
steps: Roast vermicelli in ghee.
Simmer in milk until soft.
Add sugar, cardamom and fried nuts.

recipes.name: Filter coffee
steps: Brew decoction in a coffee filter.
Mix with boiling milk and sugar and froth by pouring between tumblers.

recipes.name: Chicken 65
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, egg, flours, ginger, garlic and chilli.
Deep-fry until crisp.
Toss with fried curry leaves and green chilli.

recipes.name: Egg dosa
steps: Spread dosa batter on the tawa.
Break an egg over it with onion and pepper and spread.
Cook with oil until set.

recipes.name: Mushroom pepper fry
steps: Fry onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves.
Add mushrooms and cook until dry.
Toss with crushed pepper and fennel.

recipes.name: Mangalore buns
steps: Mash banana with sugar, curd and salt and knead in maida.
Rest 6 hours.
Roll thick and deep-fry until puffed.

recipes.name: Neer dosa
steps: Soak rice 4 hours and grind with coconut into a watery batter.
Pour thin onto a hot pan and cover briefly.
Fold into quarters without flipping.

recipes.name: Akki rotti
steps: Knead rice flour with vegetables, coconut, chilli and warm water.
Pat thin on a greased tawa.
Cook covered with a little oil.

recipes.name: Sour greens chicken (gongura style)
steps: Wilt the sour greens (spinach with tamarind stands in for gongura) and mash.
Brown onion, ginger and garlic and cook chicken with spices.
Add the greens and simmer until thick.

recipes.name: Veg kothu parotta
steps: Shred cooked parottas.
Fry onion, tomato and capsicum with spices on a flat griddle.
Add parotta and chop together with a spatula.

recipes.name: Masala vada
steps: Soak chana dal and grind coarsely.
Mix in onion, chilli, ginger, fennel and curry leaves.
Shape patties and deep-fry.

recipes.name: Tomato rice
steps: Cook rice and cool.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato with spices into a thick base.
Mix in the rice.

recipes.name: Vangi bath
steps: Cook and cool rice.
Fry brinjal strips with vangi bath powder and tamarind.
Toss with rice and the tempering.

recipes.name: Chettinad egg curry
steps: Grind roasted spices with coconut.
Cook onion and tomato, add the paste and water.
Simmer boiled eggs in the curry.

recipes.name: Rasam rice
steps: Cook rice soft.
Make a quick rasam.
Mash the rice into the rasam with a little ghee.

recipes.name: Sambar rice
steps: Cook rice and dal together.
Simmer vegetables in tamarind and sambar powder and add to the rice.
Finish with ghee and a mustard tempering.
